tasks.gr8-settlement-and-urbanisation-t3: Topic: Settlement and urbanisation. Cover rural and urban settlements, land use in towns and cities, aerial photograph interpretation, migration, and apartheid urbanisation in South Africa. Ask Grade 8 learners to classify settlement types, interpret settlement evidence, and explain push-pull factors and urban challenges.
tasks.gr8-settlement-investigation-project-t3: Topic: Investigation of a settlement (the Term 3 project). Cover the parts of the project: describing the settlement and its land uses, identifying landmarks (natural and human-made), suggesting reasons for the location, discussing growth or decline of the population and the reasons, discussing one social or environmental issue, and including interviews with community members, drawings and a sketch map. Ask Grade 8 learners how to plan, collect and present evidence honestly and in their own words. This is a guide to a formally assessed project and does not replace it.
tasks.gr8-land-use-urban-and-rural-settlements: Topic: Settlement and land use. Cover land use in urban settlements (the central business district, light and heavy industry, residential areas for high-, middle- and low-income groups, shopping centres, services and recreation), types of rural settlement (farming, mining, forestry, fishing) and land use on aerial photographs (oblique and vertical, natural and constructed features). Models of land use are not required. Use examples from Africa including South Africa. Ask Grade 8 learners to describe characteristics of zones and to identify land uses from photographs and simple maps.
